title: Report your E-Tag as lost or stolen
summary: Learn how to report your E-Toll tag as lost or stolen.
intro:
If your E-Toll tag has been lost or stolen you can report it:

You remain responsible for any toll charges on your account until you report your tag as lost or stolen.

Note: If your tag has been stolen, report it to the NSW Police Force to get a Police Event Number. If you do not have this, you will be charged a fee for not returning the tag.

If you need to replace the tag, call 13 18 65.
what_you_need: The Police Event Number (if you have one)

how_to_steps.text: Log in to your E-Toll account.
Select 'Make an enquiry' for a stolen tag or 'Tags' for a lost tag.
Follow the prompts to report the tag as stolen or lost.
The tag will be turned off and removed from your account.
There is a fee if the tag is not returned (unless you provide a Police Event Number).
If you need to replace the tag, call 13 18 65.
If you find your tag after reporting it as lost or stolen, call 13 18 65.

more_info.text: If you report your tag as lost, stolen or destroyed as a result of a declared natural disaster, you will not be charged a tag replacement fee.

internal_links.text: Change your name on an E-Toll Account

faqs.q: Who is responsible for toll charges if my E-Toll tag is lost or stolen?
faqs.a: You remain responsible for any toll charges on your account until you report your tag as lost or stolen.

faqs.q: What should I do if my E-Toll tag was stolen?
faqs.a: Report it to the NSW Police Force to get a Police Event Number. If you do not have this, you will be charged a fee for not returning the tag.

faqs.q: How do I report my E-Toll tag as lost or stolen?
faqs.a: Select the 'Report online' button, log in to your E-Toll account, select 'Make an enquiry' for a stolen tag or 'Tags' for a lost tag, follow the prompts, and select 'Submit'.
